title: Trader Diary: 75k Dip Drama
content:
📉 75,784 → -0.6% in 24h
👀 Me at 3 AM: "One more leverage, it’s just a blip"
💥 Realizing the blip is a cliff when the liquidation engine wakes up
lesson: If the price moves more than your stop‑loss, you’re doing it wrong – keep leverage low enough to survive a 2% swing.
question: Who else added a 5x long at 75.7k and now watches the chart like a horror movie? Be honest 👇
